prior_account.scope: Renderer ownership of data-source-line metadata for mixed class, object, description, state, and branch images.
prior_account.status: Retained as valid historical provenance. It was completed before the rejected parser identity work and does not explain review-4 command grammar or quark-path failures.
prior_account.invariant: Concrete Java SVEK entity-image implementations own SVG group source-line metadata: class, object, and description images construct groups with the entity location, while state and branch images construct location-free groups. Rust retains parser source locations but emits data-source-line only when the corresponding image contract owns it.

rejected_attempt.result: Rejected: 10/14 fresh scoped identity matches. Valid mixed-case and underscored allowmixing commands selected the wrong factory; package aliases used display text as identity; nested qualified endpoints duplicated existing leaves; and later declarations incorrectly retyped relationship-created entities.

invariant: PlantUML recognizes allowmixing through one complete class-command grammar: CommandAllowMixing.getRegexConcat anchors allow + optional underscore + mixing at both line boundaries, and Pattern2.compileInternal applies case-insensitive matching. Factory selection and command execution therefore accept exactly case variants of allowmixing and allow_mixing and reject trailing tokens. Class group and leaf identity is a hierarchical quark path, not display text or a flat entity ID. CommandPackage uses AS as the group quark identity and NAME only as display; CommandNamespace likewise enters a quark-backed group. CommandLinkClass resolves endpoints through CucaDiagram.quarkInContextSafe(true, name), so qualified paths whose first group exists resolve from the root and unqualified uniquely existing children can be reused. The first command that materializes an entity owns its quark, source location, and leaf type: a relationship-created endpoint is LeafType.CLASS at the relationship location, and a later CommandCreateElementFull2 declaration reuses that entity and updates display or other explicitly mutable fields without replacing its identity, source, or kind.
causal_divergence: Rust duplicates allowmixing recognition in detect_uml_subtype and ClassParser.try_meta. The former accepts only lowercase allowmixing or a lowercase allowmixing prefix, while the latter skips any lowercase line starting with allowmixing; together they reject valid mixed-case and optional-underscore commands but over-accept Java-invalid trailing text. ClassParser.try_package has no AS capture and is not end-anchored, so it partially matches a quoted package declaration, discards the alias suffix, and stores display text in Package.name as identity. ClassParser.resolve_relationship_endpoint then searches a flat ClassEntity.id list and performs only a one-package-prefix strip over Package.entities. It cannot reconstruct a nested parent path such as Outer.Inner.Leaf and falls through to ensure_entity, duplicating an existing leaf at the later relationship line. Finally, ClassParser.try_entity_decl unconditionally changes EntityKind when it finds an endpoint that ensure_entity created from a relationship, whereas Java preserves the original LeafType.CLASS and source location. These are command-grammar and hierarchical identity-model gaps, not fixture, label, relationship-count, layout, or renderer-geometry effects.
planned_change: Introduce one shared, full-line, ASCII-case-insensitive parser for the exact allow_?mixing command and use its result for both subtype selection and class-command consumption; command-shaped input with trailing tokens must remain invalid. Parse package declarations to completion and separate canonical code from display, storing AS as the group identity and NAME as presentation. Represent every package, namespace, and leaf with one canonical identity path derived from parent identity plus local code, and maintain an index from that path to the existing object; package membership remains layout data rather than the authority for identity. Route declarations and relationship endpoints through one resolver implementing the relevant CucaDiagram.quarkInContextSafe reuse rules for root-qualified, context-relative, and uniquely reusable unqualified names. Preserve first materialization ownership of entity source and kind, allowing later declarations to mutate only fields that CommandCreateElementFull2 mutates on an existing entity. Keep canonical paths for lookup and qualified-name metadata, but derive SVG relationship IDs from the endpoint's short Quark name because Link.idCommentForSvg calls Entity.getName rather than Quark.getQualifiedName. Preserve the already passing top-level declaration-order and first-use behavior. Add adjacent named Java class and method citations to every parity-affecting recognizer and branch. Do not add fixture-label conditions, source-line equality branches, entity or relationship count ladders, coordinate logic, golden reads, or post-hoc SVG rewriting.
